message.reasoning_content:
Key bugs: parse_u64 sets out=0 first, violating "out unchanged on failure" (e.g. "12x" or empty). Also overflow: out*10 wraps silently, no rejection above UINT64_MAX — contract violation (e.g. "18446744073789591617" or "99999999999999999999"). Also empty string accepted (returns true with out=0) — contract says nonempty only. Also parse_u64 marked noexcept but can't throw — fine. Registry: get returns string_view into names vector while holding lock then releasing; readers may retain view while add push_back can reallocate/move strings → dangling view. Also get(i) no bounds check. Also get returns view to names[i] — after lock released, add may push_back causing reallocation, invalidating views. Fix: return std::string (copy) or keep shared; bounds check. Also mutex lock_guard: fine.

Also parse_u64: leading zeros allowed — fine. Overflow detection: check out > (UINT64_MAX - d)/10 before multiply. Also "out unchanged on failure": must not assign out until success; use local accumulator.

Also noexcept: with fixes no throw, ok.

Minimal triggers:
1. parse_u64("12x", out) with out=7 → returns false but out becomes 0 (violates unchanged-on-failure). Also empty "" returns true — contract violation (accepts empty).
2. Overflow: "18446744073789591617" wraps → returns true with wrong value; contract requires reject.
3. Registry::get returns view; reader retains it, writer add() push_back reallocation → dangling view (use-after-free). Trigger: get(0) view retained, add many strings forcing resize.
4. get(i) no bounds check → out-of-range UB for i>=names.size().

Fixes: parse_u64 accumulate in local, reject empty, overflow check via out > (UINT64_MAX - d)/10. Registry: return std::string by value (copy under lock), bounds check; or return a copy. Also names vector reallocation invalidates string_views even for elements not moved? push_back reallocation moves elements — string_views into moved elements dangle. Copy fixes.

Also note: get returns view while lock released — even without add, view remains valid as long as no reallocation; but contract says writers keep calling add → defect.

Also style: could use std::string_view parameter fine; noexcept fine. Also could mention lock_guard naming. Keep ≤650 words, six findings, corrected parse_u64 in cpp block.
